description: This file defines the AppSyncClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS AppSync service. It uses PHPDoc annotations to declare various methods that handle operations related to AWS AppSync such as creating, deleting, and managing APIs, data sources, resolvers, and other resources.

classes.name: AppSyncClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, specifically designed for interacting with AWS AppSync service APIs.

methods.name: associateApi
methods.description: Associates an API with AWS AppSync

methods.name: associateApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an API with AWS AppSync

methods.name: createApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AppSync API

methods.name: deleteApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing AppSync API
